mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public_image_quota(owner_user_id, used_file_count, used_bytes) VALUES(#{ownerUserId}, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_user_id = VALUES(owner_user_id)
INSERT INTO public_image_asset(relative_path, owner_user_id, file_size) VALUES(#{relativePath}, #{ownerUserId}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE public_image_quota SET used_file_count = GREATEST(used_file_count - 1, 0), used_bytes = GREATEST(used_bytes - #{fileSize}, 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
